Usage of helper:
  --add-dir                       Adds a folder it may read (repeatable) (default [])
  -c                              Short alias for --continue
  --continue                      Goes on with the last talk
  --dangerously-skip-permissions  Asks nothing at all
  --effort                        How hard it thinks (low|medium|high)
  --mode                          How it works (edit, plan, review)
  --model                         The model for this run
  -p                              Short alias for --print
  --print                         Prints one answer and ends
  --prompt                        Alias for --print
  --output-format                 How the answer is printed (text, json) (default text)

Available subcommands:
  help    Shows the help of a subcommand
  models  Lists the models
